- Added the CS2 Tasks icon to the Windows executable and its shortcuts.
- The system tray menu now switches between English and Russian as soon as you change the dashboard language.

Download **CS2Tasks.exe** from **Assets**. To update, exit CS2 Tasks from the tray and replace the executable in the same folder.
